usedFor: Shopify holds shoppers and checkouts, and Zagomail keeps the mailing list through “Create a Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create a Subscriber” in Zagomail
bestTemplate.why: An abandoned checkout carries an email, so the shopper can join a list for follow-up.

watchOut: “Create a Subscriber” adds people to a specified mailing list, so pick that list with care.
